architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. React Router v6 for navigation. Tailwind CSS for styling. No state management lib (use React context + hooks). API client in src/api/.

tickets.title: Build Beranda (Home) page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch beranda_home screen to React. Extract reusable components (HeroBanner, ProductCard, EventCard). Use Tailwind for styling. Responsive layout. Hardcode data for now. API integration later.

tickets.title: Build Masuk (Login) and Daftar Akun (Register) pages
tickets.description: Create Login and Register pages. Shared AuthForm component. Form validation (required fields, email format). Mock auth flow (localStorage token). Redirect to home on success.

tickets.title: Build Detail Produk (Product Detail) and Detail Event Katalog (Event Detail) pages
tickets.description: Product and Event detail pages. Shared DetailLayout component. Image gallery. Add-to-cart button. Hardcode data. API integration later.

tickets.title: Build Daftar Pesanan Saya (My Orders) and Detail Pesanan (Order Detail) pages
tickets.description: My Orders list page. Order detail page. Status badges. Cancellation request button. Hardcode data. API integration later.

tickets.title: Build Ajukan Pembatalan (Cancellation Request) and Upload Bukti Pembayaran (Payment Proof) pages
tickets.description: Cancellation request form. Payment proof upload form. File upload component. Form validation. Mock submission flow.

tickets.title: Build Notifikasi (Notifications) and Schedule Calendar pages
tickets.description: Notifications list page. Calendar view for schedule. Notification item component. Hardcode data. API integration later.

tickets.title: Build Admin Dashboard Overview page
tickets.description: Admin dashboard with stats, charts, recent activity. Hardcode data. API integration later. Responsive layout.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Main App shell. Navigation bar. React Router v6 setup. Route definitions for all pages. Auth context provider. Responsive layout. 404 page.
